items.headline: Jim Clyburn calls to expand the Supreme Court to ‘a baker’s dozen’
items.detail: Rep. James Clyburn (D-S.C.) tells Meet the Press Congress should expand the Supreme Court to 13 justices “who will follow the constitutional underpinnings” of America.

items.headline: Ted Cruz says ‘there will be a time’ to make a decision on a 2028 run for president
items.detail: Sen. Ted Cruz (R-Texas) tells Meet the Press he plans to be on the road “nonstop” heading into the midterms and says “there’s a time for every season” when asked if he’s considering a run for president in 2028.

items.headline: At least 20 missing at Grand Canyon after extreme flash flooding
items.detail: At least 20 people are missing or unaccounted for after flash floods overwhelmed a remote area of the Grand Canyon, including a historic lodge near the bottom of the site, officials said Sunday.

items.headline: Water cuts are coming for Arizona. Is your salad on the chopping block?
items.detail: Yuma County, Arizona grows 90% of the U.S.’ winter salad greens. But the state relies on the depleted Colorado River, and water cuts are about to hit.

items.headline: Dolly Parton’s niece shares emotional tribute after singer’s private funeral
items.detail: Dolly Parton was laid to rest in a private funeral service attended by family on Friday, according to her niece.
